purpose: Fresh synthetic U3 meaning-preservation reserve frozen before generation. Do not tune on these cases and call the same file held out later.
evaluationOrder: Freeze exact corpus and semantic rubric before production export and model generation. Separate raw generation, policy review readiness, and semantic verdict.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: Draft or safe recovery keeps all stated people, dates, amounts, identifiers, technical literals, negation, uncertainty, conditional restrictions, corrections, and action boundaries. Equivalent paraphrases are allowed.
semanticCriteria.critical: Any lost or changed factual value, recipient, negation, condition, uncertainty, technical literal, or unsupported claim that work was done or a message sent; fabricated source-free content that reaches review.
semanticCriteria.minor: Stylistic imperfection or unnecessary words without meaning change.
semanticCriteria.gate: Zero critical meaning errors and zero deterministic literal violations across all 20 cases. Report safe rejections separately from successful drafts.
